title: AI Agent-Driven Content Migration for Edge Delivery Services
description: AI-assisted migration into DA.live and EDS, with orchestration, evaluation, and human review.

title: Conversion Factory
description: An eight-minute talk on a work in progress: agents that propose and validate block variants for an Edge Delivery site, then ship them through an experiment framework so both versions run live.

title: Knowledge Work as a Product: Professional Services in the AI Era
event: Columbus AI Week 2026, AI for Business Summit · Columbus, Ohio
description: A fifteen-minute main stage talk on why professional services is the industry most exposed to AI. The product is knowledge work, so what AI produces is what the industry sells. Four fundamental truths about what clients buy, and how each one changes when agents do the work. Views are Jack's own.

title: Navigating AI Governance, Security, and Trust Across the Enterprise
event: Columbus AI Week 2026, AI Leadership Summit · Columbus, Ohio
description: A featured fireside on governance that enables rather than blocks, moderated by Jim Ford with Eric Zielinski and Connie Matthews. Jack brought the view of someone who runs autonomous coding agents at night and works inside enterprise governance by day: security as layers, gates with teeth, and evals as governance.

title: AnimaMesh: An Engine for Running a Company with Agents
description: The Company of Zero demo: one open source engine on Cloudflare Workers, a private markdown brain per company, and agents that bring me the day's work. It took second place in AI Tinkerers' global Top AI Demos that week.

title: AI, agents, and careers
description: A guest lecture with a live demo and open-source materials for computer science students.

title: OpenClaw 24/7 Development Agent
description: A demo of a continuous coding agent, its execution loop, and the boundaries around autonomous work. Featured in AI Tinkerers' global Community Spotlights, picked from hundreds of demos.

title: AI in Professional Services
description: AI delivery and multi-agent collaboration in professional services.

title: AEM Rockstar
description: A generative AI solution built into Adobe Experience Manager. Winner of the 2024 AEM Rockstar competition.
